title: 一個一個找 vs 二分搜尋
question:
書架上有 1 號到 n 號的書，照順序排好。要找 x 號書：
1. 一個一個找：從 1 號開始一本一本看，看到 x 號就停
2. 二分搜尋：左 = 1、右 = n，每次看中間那本（(左 + 右) / 2，無條件捨去），太小往右半找、太大往左半找
輸入 n 和 x，輸出兩種方法各看了幾本：「一個一個找：幾」「二分搜尋：幾」。
想想看：書變成 1000 倍，兩種方法各要多看幾本？

test_case.output:
一個一個找：100
二分搜尋：7

一個一個找：50
二分搜尋：1

一個一個找：99999
二分搜尋：16

en.title: One by One vs Binary Search
en.question:
A shelf has books 1 to n in order. To find book x:
1. One by one: look from book 1, one at a time, and stop at book x
2. Binary search: left = 1, right = n. Each time look at the middle book ((left + right) / 2, round down). If it is too small, look in the right half; if too big, the left half
Input n and x. Output how many books each way looks at: "One by one: " and "Binary search: ".
Think: with 1000 times more books, how many more does each way look at?

test_case.note: A big difference with many books
